authoring.source: 第 18 版质量池验证集（按片留出）重切窗口并按第 18 版合同重标（tools/data/build_benchmark.py）
authoring.rule: 6–12 镜、≤60 秒、训练同一质量门；至少一处镜内变化、一个跨镜人物、一个动作镜；每片至多 3 段；按片随机（seed 42）分开发集至少 30 个故事

synopsis.text: A woman points a spear at a bandaged young man with an eyepatch, who looks shocked, before a brief cut to another young man surrounded by giant limbs.

paragraph.text: A woman with long black hair and a red headband stands on a staircase in front of a dark building with pentagrams and a large eye. She smiles menacingly and points a long spear at a young man with an eyepatch and bandages on his chest and arm. The young man looks shocked and speaks. The scene cuts to a blonde young man standing in a red room surrounded by giant disembodied limbs. The scene cuts back to the young man with the eyepatch looking down in shock.

synopsis.text: Magic transforms a village tree into a blooming wonder, and a pink female troll is crowned and celebrated by a crowd before sharing a heartfelt hug with a blue male troll.

paragraph.text: Rainbow-colored magic spreads across a whimsical village, reaching a large bare tree in the center of a roundabout, which then blooms with green leaves and sparkling lights. The scene shifts to a grassy area where a large crowd of trolls and creatures dance and celebrate around a mushroom stage. An older male troll places a large green leaf crown on a pink female troll's head. They smile and raise their arms together as the crowd cheers. The pink female troll is then approached by a blue male troll with a tall purple afro; they look at each other, hold hands, and share a warm hug.
